$copyright: Each component's own copyright line, taken from that project's LICENSE or, for the fonts, from the OFL file the font itself ships. Needed because texts/ holds the SPDX template for each licence, and an SPDX template says `Copyright (c) <year> <owner>`. Shipping that placeholder discharges nothing: BSD and Apache both require the actual notice to travel with the binary. Never compose one of these lines by hand.
